description: (Na)₂NaYI₆ is alpha Rhenium trioxide-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a NaYI₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaYI₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent I atoms to form NaI₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent YI₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-I bond lengths are 3.10 Å. Y is bonded to six equivalent I atoms to form YI₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaI₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Y-I bond lengths are 3.01 Å. I is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Y atom.
